CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation tied to identified content in the text.

COD.rationale: Content (color at coordinates), an explicit organization description and an explicit origin/status field are all present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to content organization/access is stated.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names content items (color labels) with coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origins/estimate/kind fields separately attribute provenance/status to the identified content.

O.rationale: The text states how coordinates map to rows/columns and presents structured coordinate lists for contents.
